0.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000010_MERLWYB
0.description: Ere we begin, I would like to offer my gratitude to Masters Thancred and Urianger. 'Tis no small feat to infiltrate the imperial capital and live to tell the tale, much less in times of civil war. Thanks to them, we may plot our course in full knowledge of how the winds blow in Garlemald.

1.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000020_URIANGER
1.description: Full glad are we to have been of service. But verily, such dangers as we did encounter pale into insignificance next to those faced by our comrades. An Ascian armed with the might of Bahamut, bent on bringing about the Final Days...

2.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000030_RAUBAHN
2.description: Theatrics. He sought only to make a show of the power at the Telophoroi's disposal.

3.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000040_RAUBAHN
3.description: But since then, we have seen no sign of this “Fandaniel,” or his wyrm. And while we've done what we can to bolster our defenses, there's no telling where he might strike next.

4.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000050_KANESENNA
4.description: Whenever and wherever it may be, we must use the intervening time to learn more of our enemy.

5.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000060_KANESENNA
5.description: 'Twas with this in mind that we dispatched scouts to investigate the towers...

6.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000070_LYSE
6.description: Our advance party took longer than expected to return...and when they did, they tried to kill us.

7.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000080_LYSE
7.description: Luckily, I'd seen that sort of thing before, and we were able to restrain them before they did any harm. Then it was just a matter of letting the porxies do their work.

8.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000090_ALISAIE
8.description: Are you saying they were tempered?

9.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000100_LYSE
9.description: Once they'd come back to their senses, they told us everything they could. It seems that just as they were getting close to the tower, they heard an earsplitting roar. And that was the last thing they remembered.

10.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000110_LYSE
10.description: But what worries me most is what they were saying right before they attacked.

12.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000130_URIANGER
12.description: The tempered have heretofore ever been thralls to primal entities. Yet these hapless souls were compelled to accept a <hex:021A020203>nation<hex:021A020103> as the object of their devotion. This calleth into question all that we know of the condition.

13.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000140_AYMERIC
13.description: Would that the unsettling news ended there. Alas, there is more. Following the earlier reports of missing Amalj'aa, we have learned that other beast tribes have suffered similar losses.

14.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000150_AYMERIC
14.description: And we now have reason to believe that the abductions are connected to the appearance of the towers.

15.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000160_AYMERIC
15.description: Our scouts sighted black-garbed figures leading shackled Ixal in the direction of the tower in Dravania.

16.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000170_AYMERIC
16.description: The Temple Knights were able to intercept them before they could reach their destination, liberating the Ixal and apprehending their captors─each of whom was found to be equipped with Garlean arms and armor.

17.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000180_GRAHATIA
17.description: So the Empire is the common thread.

18.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000190_NANAMOULNAMO
18.description: With the support of Zenos, it seems likely that Fandaniel has rallied a faction of the splintered Garlean army to the banner of the Telophoroi.

19.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000200_RAUBAHN
19.description: Lord Hien reached the same conclusion when I shared our findings with Doma.

20.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000210_RAUBAHN
20.description: The plan had been to march on Garlemald from the east and west in order to force a peace treaty, but the situation has changed. Dealing with the threat of the towers must come first.

21.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000220_RAUBAHN
21.description: Given the nature of the enemy, and the proven risk of tempering, I could think of few suitable candidates to aid in this task. But I am confident in my choice.

23.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000240_RAUBAHN
23.description: Resistant to primal influence as they are, they can investigate the towers without fear of being turned.

24.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000250_ARENVALD
24.description: We're glad to put our gifts to use, Commander.

25.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000260_RAUBAHN
25.description: Gifted or not, going behind enemy lines remains a perilous undertaking. But we must know more if we're to strike back at our foe. I'm counting on you.

26.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000270_ARENVALD
26.description: If it would give us the upper hand, I'd do it a hundred times over. We won't let you down.

27.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000280_RAUBAHN
27.description: That concludes the briefing. You two─make ready and join your escort.

28.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000290_ALPHINAUD
28.description: Are you certain about this, Arenvald?

29.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000300_ARENVALD
29.description: I am. Come on, let's talk outside.

30.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000310_ARENVALD
30.description: So you know, I've already gone through all the formalities at the Rising Stones. Made sure to inform J'moldva and V'mah at Rhalgr's Reach as well.

31.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000320_ALPHINAUD
31.description: Arenvald, I admire your enthusiasm...but this is far more dangerous than anything you have done before.

32.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000330_ARENVALD
32.description: I know the risks. And I also know what's in store if we don't stop Fandaniel from carrying out his plan.

33.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000340_ARENVALD
33.description: With this power of mine, I can make a difference. If I stood idly by, I would regret it for the rest of my life.

34.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000350_ALPHINAUD
34.description: And you, Fordola? Is this what you want?

35.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000360_FORDOLA
35.description: What're you asking me for? It's not like I have any say in the matter.

36.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000370_ARENVALD
36.description: Don't pretend. We both know Commander Aldynn gave you a chance to refuse. And you didn't.

38.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000390_FORDOLA
38.description: So the Empire's finished, is it? That's what they're all saying. That the great and glorious Garlemald slit its own throat.

39.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000400_FORDOLA
39.description: And now, from out of its twitching carcass crawls the Telophoroi, with bloody <hex:021A020203>Zenos<hex:021A020103> at its head.

40.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000410_FORDOLA
40.description: I fought for Garlemald. Killed for Garlemald. What was I a part of? I need to know. Whatever it is...I need to know.

41.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000420_ALPHINAUD
41.description: Very well. If your hearts are set on this, I shall not stand in your way.

42.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000430_THANCRED
42.description: If you've finished with your touching display of camaraderie, I have a question: which tower are you planning to investigate, exactly?

43.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000440_ARENVALD
43.description: Well, the one in Gyr Abania's said to be tightly guarded. It's patrol after patrol out there, apparently. We'd be spotted before we got anywhere near it.

44.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000450_ARENVALD
44.description: Which is why we've set our sights on the one in Paglth'an, instead. There shouldn't be anything like as many imperials to worry about down there.

45.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000460_THANCRED
45.description: Even so, I doubt the local Amalj'aa will look kindly on it if they catch you sneaking around in their territory.

46.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000470_ARENVALD
46.description: Fordola and I had a chance to learn the lie of the land in our previous forays there. We might still find trouble, but at least we won't lose our way.

47.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000480_ARENVALD
47.description: Well, we'd best not keep them waiting any longer.

48.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000490_ALPHINAUD
48.description: Mayhap when all of this is over, we could take another trip to Loch Seld. I would have you know I've become a rather capable swimmer since our last visit.

49.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000500_ARENVALD
49.description: Ha! I'll believe that when I see it! Though, to be fair, getting into deep water does seem to be a Scion's lot in life... Take care, eh?

50.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000510_ARENVALD
50.description: It means a lot, you know─you coming with me.

51.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000520_FORDOLA
51.description: I still owe you for saving my skin, don't I? Can't return the favor if I'm not there.

52.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000530_ARENVALD
52.description: I daresay you'll get your chance before long. That Fandaniel sounds like a tricky customer. Too much for the likes of me, anyway.

53.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000540_ARENVALD
53.description: But we both know I'd be just another soldier if it weren't for my gift. And I need to be a damn sight more than that, given what's coming.

54.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000550_ARENVALD
54.description: I realize I can't hold a candle to a hero like the Warrior of Light─or Alphinaud, for that matter. He might look like he's twelve, but he's seen more action than most people see in a lifetime.

55.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000560_ARENVALD
55.description: No, the fact is, I'm nothing like them, and maybe I never will be, but I'll be damned if I don't try.

56.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000570_ARENVALD
56.description: They're counting on me. On us. So let's give it our all.

57.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000580_ALPHINAUD
57.description: He does not want for conviction, that much is certain. So let us have faith in him. Him and Fordola both.

58.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000590_ALPHINAUD
58.description: While they see to the towers, I would attend to another task: chasing down this “Lunar” Bahamut.

59.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000600_TATARU
59.description: (-Tataru-)(Ugh! Bloody thing...) Can you hear me? It's Tataru. I'm happy to say we managed to find Estinien!

60.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000610_TATARU
60.description: (-Tataru-)And...I'm sorry to say he went running off again the moment we told him about Bahamut.

61.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000620_TATARU
61.description: (-Tataru-)But he did mutter something about heading to Ishgard, so if you're quick, you might still be able to catch him!

62.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000630_ALPHINAUD
62.description: Even if we set out this instant, he may already have left by the time we arrive. Have her send the <hex:021A020203>Bonanza<hex:021A020103> to Ishgard. It may prove useful should we need to give chase.

63.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000640_TATARU
63.description: (-Tataru-)Gladly! I'll see to it as soon as Krile and I get back to the Rising Stones. Good luck!

64.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000650_THANCRED
64.description: While you go off on your dragoon hunt, Urianger and I will return to headquarters. We have much to tell the others.

65.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000651_URIANGER
65.description: I wish you every success in your search for our elusive friend. May we all meet again ere long.

66.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000660_ALISAIE
66.description: No sign of him. Not that I've ever met him before. But the way Alphinaud goes on about him, I'm fairly sure I could pick him out in a crowd.

67.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000670_GRAHATIA
67.description: Speaking of which, it does seem awfully quiet. If the erstwhile Azure Dragoon had returned to Ishgard, would it not be a source of general excitement?

68.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000680_ESTINIEN
68.description: First the Scions' coinkeeper, and now you. I'm beginning to think these meetings are more than mere coincidence.

69.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000690_ESTINIEN
69.description: Not that I'm complaining. It's been too long.

71.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000710_ESTINIEN
71.description: You look an ilm taller and twice as rugged. It suits you, Alphinaud.

72.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000720_ESTINIEN
72.description: Quieter, though. Have you been giving him lessons on how to be the strong, silent type?

76.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000760_ALISAIE
76.description: If the two of you are such firm friends, perhaps you should remember what he looks like! And what do you mean, “rugged”!?

77.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000770_ALISAIE
77.description: Ungh! Had my brother mentioned what an oaf you are, I'd never have bothered looking for you in the first place!

78.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000780_GRAHATIA
78.description: Estinien Wyrmblood, the Azure Dragoon... He who fought and felled the dread wyrm Nidhogg at the Warrior of Light's side!

79.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000790_GRAHATIA
79.description: To think the day would come when I should see this living legend with my own eyes!

80.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000800_ESTINIEN
80.description: Would someone mind explaining what is going on?

81.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000810_ALPHINAUD
81.description: Is everything all right!? I thought I heard Alisaie shouting...

83.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000830_ALPHINAUD
83.description: No, no, it's quite understandable. That was hardly the first time we've been confused for one another. Nor, I suspect, will it be the last.

84.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000840_ESTINIEN
84.description: Well I for one will not be making that mistake again.

85.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000850_ESTINIEN
85.description: What I will say...for the second time today...is that you've grown. Inside and out. I can tell.

86.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000860_ALPHINAUD
86.description: One can't remain a spoiled little lordling forever, you know.

87.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000870_ALISAIE
87.description: At least someone's having a good time...

88.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000880_ALISAIE
88.description: You know, when we were growing up, Alphinaud would never befriend other boys because he couldn't stand the thought of not being in charge. But maybe that's changed. He seems just as happy around Estinien as he does Arenvald.

90.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_A1_000_001_NONE_VOICE
90.description: Perhaps he sees them as the brothers he never had.

91.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_A1_000_002_NONE_VOICE
91.description: I think he learned how to talk <hex:021A020203>with<hex:021A020103> people rather than <hex:021A020203>at<hex:021A020103> them.

92.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_A1_000_003_NONE_VOICE
92.description: Well...you can't keep him all to yourself forever.

93.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000890_ALISAIE
93.description: Hmph. Good luck to them. It hasn't been easy being his sister, I can tell you that.

94.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000900_ALISAIE
94.description: I wouldn't be so sure. He still loves nothing better than the sound of his own voice.

95.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000910_ALISAIE
95.description: Keep him to my─!? You're joking, aren't you? I'd be <hex:021A020203>glad<hex:021A020103> if someone would take him off my hands!

96.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000920_ESTINIEN
96.description: No rest for the righteous, eh? Speaking of which, I was just on my way to borrow an airship to take me to Azys Lla.

97.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000930_ALPHINAUD
97.description: Azys Lla...? How could I forget? The dragon with whom Bahamut shared the deepest of bonds...

98.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000940_ESTINIEN
98.description: Aye, Tiamat, his mate. Even now, she remains imprisoned on Azys Lla, though her remorse binds her faster than any shackle.

99.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000950_GRAHATIA
99.description: I see... As the one who first summoned Bahamut, you believe she may be able to shine some light on his latest incarnation.

100.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000960_ALPHINAUD
100.description: Might I suggest that we make the journey to Azys Lla together? I'm not sure if Tataru mentioned this, but we Scions have an airship of our own now.

101.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000970_ESTINIEN
101.description: I see no reason why not...assuming your sister can bear the thought of sharing a deck with me.

102.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000980_ALISAIE
102.description: Be my guest. But confuse me with Alphinaud again, and I'll throw you overboard.

103.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_000990_ALISAIE
103.description: Ugh! I don't know who he thinks he is, but he's nothing like Alphinaud painted him to be!

104.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001000_GRAHATIA
104.description: I will admit, he is not exactly as I imagined him either. Based on what I had read of the man, I think I was expecting someone a little less...blunt?

105.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001010_TIAMAT
105.description: (-Tiamat-)My sire's mortal companion... What bringeth thee back to this forsaken place, child of man?

106.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001020_ESTINIEN
106.description: Hmph. It's plain she knows naught of recent events. Perhaps you should enlighten her.

107.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001030_TIAMAT
107.description: (-Tiamat-)Ahhh... That my sins should be repeated...

109.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001050_TIAMAT
109.description: (-Tiamat-)As to who could have called him forth...I know of none save the dragons of Meracydia. Our children...

110.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001060_TIAMAT
110.description: (-Tiamat-)The eikon claimed their souls when first he manifested. And robbed of their will, they became tools for the Allagans' dark designs.

111.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001070_ALISAIE
111.description: Much like those held here in Azys Lla. If dragons who worship Bahamut are required to summon him, that must mean...

112.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001080_ALISAIE
112.description: I've seen it with my own eyes. Captives of a lost empire, neither alive nor dead, existing only to preserve Bahamut's corporeal form.

113.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001090_TIAMAT
113.description: (-Tiamat-)Yes. The dragons of Meracydia are at the mercy of this Ascian. There can be no other explanation.

115.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001110_TIAMAT
115.description: (-Tiamat-)Again you would profane the memory of my beloved, and strip our children of their freedom, their dignity! Are there no depths to which you will not stoop!?

116.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001120_ESTINIEN
116.description: Your children's pain means nothing to them. They laugh at your kind's suffering.

117.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001130_ESTINIEN
117.description: But tears will not right this wrong. Nor will lamentations see the perpetrators punished.

118.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001140_TIAMAT
118.description: (-Tiamat-)What wouldst thou have from me, slayer of dragons?

120.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001160_ESTINIEN
120.description: We came here to ask mighty Tiamat of the first brood, consort of Bahamut, mother of the dragons of Meracydia, what she intends to do about the crimes committed against her children!

121.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001170_TIAMAT
121.description: (-Tiamat-)Were I free, I would answer thine insolence with fire. But words shall have to suffice.

122.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001180_TIAMAT
122.description: (-Tiamat-)Recall, mortals, that it was I who did first summon my beloved, praying with all my being to bring him forth. You who contend with eikons cannot well be ignorant of the consequence.

123.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001190_ALPHINAUD
123.description: ...You too were exposed to his influence. That you are yet in possession of your own will is testament to the indomitable strength of your soul.

124.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001200_ALPHINAUD
124.description: But were you to meet with Bahamut again, you fear you might succumb.

125.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001210_TIAMAT
125.description: (-Tiamat-)Indeed. Ask the dragonslayer, and he will tell thee the power we of the first brood wield. Were I to lose myself to the eikon's influence, all would pay the price.

126.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001220_TIAMAT
126.description: (-Tiamat-)But it is of little matter. For even had I the strength to resist, I yet lack the strength to break my shackles. This prison shall be my tomb.

127.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001230_ALISAIE
127.description: On the matter of Bahamut's influence, at least, I believe we can be of some assistance.

128.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001240_ALISAIE
128.description: If you're afraid of being enthralled, don't be─we have a cure. And while we've never tried it on one such as you, its basic principles are universal.

130.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001260_ALPHINAUD
130.description: There is no future for those bound to the past.

131.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001270_ALPHINAUD
131.description: That you committed a terrible sin, I do not dispute. But if you feel remorse, you may yet make amends. We offer you that chance. Take it, or you will forever remain a prisoner, not of these cruel shackles, but of your own guilt.

132.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001280_TIAMAT
132.description: (-Tiamat-)A chance to make amends... To lay Bahamut's memory to rest...

133.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001290_TIAMAT
133.description: (-Tiamat-)When our own star faced annihilation, Hydaelyn granted us sanctuary. And now your foes would bring about Her destruction. This I cannot allow. For the debt I owe to Hydaelyn, and to all who have suffered for my sins...I shall fight with you, children of man.

136.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001320_TIAMAT
136.description: (-Tiamat-)Yes...I feel it! The eikon's grip groweth weak!

139.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001350_GRAHATIA
139.description: We won't know for certain until the shackles are removed.

140.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001360_TIAMAT
140.description: (-Tiamat-)Answer me this, children of man... Can my kindred be saved in like manner?

141.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001370_GRAHATIA
141.description: Many have been subjected to the Allagans' dark arts, their flesh irrevocably altered. For such tortured souls, I fear there can be no salvation.

143.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001390_TIAMAT
143.description: (-Tiamat-)Should you hearken unto my call, we shall fly together once more. But should you not...I shall grant you peace.

144.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001400_TIAMAT
144.description: (-Tiamat-)Better to die than live as a tool of evil. You too would wish this, I know...and I shall do as I must.

145.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001410_ALISAIE
145.description: When that time comes, you won't be alone. We'll stand by you.

148.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001440_ESTINIEN
148.description: Do it, and let's hope the treatment worked as it should.

152.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001480_GRAHATIA
152.description: Urianger, your timing could not be better.

154.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001500_GRAHATIA
154.description: It's Bahamut. He's been sighted over Paglth'an.

155.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001510_GRAHATIA
155.description: He flies for the largest Amalj'aa settlement in the region─at the head of a vast host, including dragons.

156.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001520_ESTINIEN
156.description: Did you hear all that, Alphinaud? You'd best rejoin your comrades. I'll make my own way.

158.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001540_TIAMAT
158.description: Ascian vermin! You shall torment my children no longer!

159.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001550_TIAMAT
159.description: Children of man... The shade of my beloved is no more, and I...I shall be forever in your debt.

160.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001560_TIAMAT
160.description: By your deeds are we set free. And free we shall remain, as long as I draw breath. Never again shall the dragons of Meracydia hearken to the lies of the Ascians. This I vow.

161.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001570_AMALJAACHIEFTAIN
161.description: (-???-)Noble warriors! The dragons chose their friends well...

162.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001580_AMALJAACHIEFTAIN
162.description: Long have our peoples waged war, but no more.

163.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001590_AMALJAACHIEFTAIN
163.description: Your fallen lie beside our own. By our words and deeds shall we honor their sacrifice.

165.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_A2_000_001_NONE_VOICE
165.description: You would make peace with Ul'dah then?

166.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_A2_000_002_NONE_VOICE
166.description: We would be proud to call you our allies.

167.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_A2_000_003_NONE_VOICE
167.description: Then let us put the past behind us.

168.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001600_AMALJAACHIEFTAIN
168.description: The enemy of our enemy is our friend, and you have proven yourselves worthy of our trust. It is the Garleans who are deserving of our fury.

169.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001610_AMALJAACHIEFTAIN
169.description: I shall see that my brethren learn the truth of this day, and rally as many as possible to the cause. Till we meet again.

170.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001620_GRAHATIA
170.description: And thus did we make allies of the Amalj'aa...

171.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001630_THANCRED
171.description: It would certainly seem that way. The sultana <hex:021A020203>will<hex:021A020103> be pleased. Let's go and give her the good news, shall we?

172.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001640_SYSTEM_NONE_VOICE
172.description: Some time earlier, inside the Paglth'an tower...

173.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001650_ARENVALD
173.description: What in Rhalgr's name happened here?

174.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001660_FORDOLA
174.description: The gods only know... But you can bet these poor sods aren't here by choice.

175.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001670_ARENVALD
175.description: Quickly, we've got to get them free!

178.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001700_FORDOLA
178.description: It's too late for them! We're leaving. Now!

181.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001730_ARENVALD
181.description: Don't you dare! We came together, and we're leaving together!

182.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001740_ALPHINAUD
182.description: Fordola... Have you been waiting here all this time?

183.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001750_DAMIELLIOT
183.description: We have done what we can. The rest is up to him.

185.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001770_DAMIELLIOT
185.description: I...do not think that wise. You must let him sleep.

186.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001780_ALPHINAUD
186.description: Thank you for bringing him back. He owes you his life.

187.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001790_ALPHINAUD
187.description: I just... I just <hex:021A020203>wish<hex:021A020103> I'd been there. Perhaps─ I don't know. Perhaps I could have...

188.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001800_FORDOLA
188.description: Could've what? Got tempered!? Don't flatter yourself. You can't save everyone. No one can. Not even the Warrior of bloody Light.

189.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001810_FORDOLA
189.description: People die all the time. For no good reason. And those who take up the sword die quicker than most.

190.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001820_FORDOLA
190.description: If you're going to shed a tear every time a soldier falls on the battlefield, you'd best stay away. It's no place for the weak of heart.

192.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001840_ALPHINAUD
192.description: That victory cannot be won without cost.

193.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001850_ALPHINAUD
193.description: But all life is precious, and I refuse to shrug at its loss!

194.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001860_FORDOLA
194.description: “All life is precious”? Hmph. You need to grow up, little man─before your sparkling ideals get everyone killed.

195.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001870_ESTINIEN
195.description: You're right. He <hex:021A020203>is<hex:021A020103> idealistic. But the world has more than its fair share of realists like you and me.

196.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001880_ESTINIEN
196.description: It's people like him who dare to dream that things could be better─and make it happen, against all the odds. They are the ones whose names live on forever. The heroes.

197.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001890_FORDOLA
197.description: The battlefield's littered with would-be heroes. At this rate, you lot'll be next.

198.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001900_FORDOLA
198.description: And what'll become of your precious dreams then!?

199.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001910_FORDOLA
199.description: They'll be gone─like dust on the wind!

200.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001920_ESTINIEN
200.description: Dreams worth fighting for don't die so easily.

201.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001930_ALPHINAUD
201.description: Your Grace. Pray forgive us our lateness.

202.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001940_NANAMOULNAMO
202.description: Think not of that. I understand a close comrade of yours was wounded in the line of duty. Arenvald.

203.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001950_NANAMOULNAMO
203.description: It was at the Alliance's behest that he risked all, and we are grieved to hear of his condition. Rest assured, he will receive the finest care our chirurgeons can provide, on that you have my word.

204.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001960_NANAMOULNAMO
204.description: Now...we would share with you the findings of the mission.

205.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001970_NANAMOULNAMO
205.description: Pipin─pray relate to our guests the details of Fordola's account.

206.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001980_THANCRED
206.description: First Bahamut, now Ifrit. Or “Lunar Ifrit,” as Fandaniel would doubtless have it.

207.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_001990_URIANGER
207.description: 'Tis now all but certain that the towers were conceived to facilitate the summoning of primals by those imprisoned within.

208.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002000_URIANGER
208.description: Less certain is the means by which the Telophoroi constrain the wills of said entities to enact <hex:021A020203>their<hex:021A020103> designs in defiance of the pleas of their victims.

209.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002010_YSHTOLA
209.description: Mayhap they do not. If mere proximity to the towers is enough to make loyal servants of the Empire's mortal enemies, it stands to reason that the same is true for those held captive.

210.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002020_YSHTOLA
210.description: They invoke their gods for the good of Garlemald, and in their disturbed state of mind summon a primal whose form reflects their own alteration.

211.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002030_THANCRED
211.description: It all begins to make sense. Upon closer inspection, I realized that the towers bear a striking resemblance to a much larger structure which Urianger and I observed from afar during our visit to the imperial capital.

212.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002040_THANCRED
212.description: Assuming it too is capable of tempering those in its immediate vicinity, it would go some way to explain the swiftness with which the Telophoroi managed to rally so many imperials to their cause.

213.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002050_NANAMOULNAMO
213.description: While the situation in Garlemald is indeed troubling, I fear we have more immediate concerns.

214.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002060_NANAMOULNAMO
214.description: Ifrit was not the only primal summoned. At approximately the same time, observers at several other towers bore witness to the emergence of further such entities.

215.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002070_NANAMOULNAMO
215.description: For a blessing, none appear to wield aught approaching the destructive power of Bahamut, and the Grand Companies are moving to deal with the threat even as we speak.

217.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_A3_000_001_NONE_VOICE
217.description: You need only tell me where they are, Your Grace...

218.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_A3_000_002_NONE_VOICE
218.description: The Grand Companies, Your Grace? Is that wise?

219.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002080_NANAMOULNAMO
219.description: Though we are aware that the task will not be easy, we would call upon the Scions only as a last resort. Pray conserve your strength for now.

220.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002090_NANAMOULNAMO
220.description: After all, it was not so very long ago that you rid us of Bahamut. On which note, I am pleased to report that our talks with the Amalj'aa have reached an agreeable conclusion. They have pledged their full support to our cause.

221.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002100_NANAMOULNAMO
221.description: It is our hope that this historic agreement will encourage other tribes to join us at the negotiating table. And I know that I speak for all of the Allied leaders when I say that we will welcome them with open arms at such time as they do.

222.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002110_NANAMOULNAMO
222.description: Of course, this was only made possible by the feats of heroism performed at Paglth'an. Moreover, we shall not allow the sacrifices of those fallen in battle to have been made in vain. As hope leads to victory, shall victory lead to a new dawn for Eorzea.

223.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002120_YSHTOLA
223.description: May these words ever be our guide, Your Grace.

224.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002130_NANAMOULNAMO
224.description: Now, if you will forgive me, I must consult with the Syndicate on the matter of our new allies' integration. Till next we meet, my friends, I bid you safe travels and blessed respite.

225.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002140_KRILE
225.description: Welcome back. I expect you must all be exhausted. Ere you take your rest, however, I would beg a moment of your time.

226.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002150_KRILE
226.description: Thanks to Arenvald's selfless efforts, we may now be confident that we understand the function of the towers. But many questions remain regarding the reason for the summonings and what lurks behind the looming edifice in Garlemald.

227.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002160_KRILE
227.description: Until such questions are answered, we will struggle to devise an effective strategy for thwarting the Telophoroi's stated aim: nothing less than the destruction of this star. And so, given the gravity of the situation...I move that we petition the aid of Sharlayan.

228.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002170_URIANGER
228.description: 'Tis possible the ancient knowledge preserved within their archives may hide a clue to our enemy's methods. But given Sharlayan's established policy of nonintervention, our former colleagues are not like to aid us in its discovery.

229.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002180_KRILE
229.description: Oh, I well remember what they're like. The Forum's barefaced refusal to assist you in the days prior to the Calamity must rank as Sharlayan's most shameful act since the exodus.

230.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002190_KRILE
230.description: But were the Final Days to be reenacted, it would spell doom for us all. Surely even they cannot turn a blind eye to that.

231.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002200_KRILE
231.description: I trust we are all of the same mind on this matter... Urgent as it seemed, I took the liberty of petitioning the Alliance for leave to act as Eorzea's emissary. And have since received their blessing.

232.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002210_GRAHATIA
232.description: I presume your role as a Student of Baldesion will carry some weight with the Forum?

233.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002220_KRILE
233.description: One can but hope. If truth be told, our organization has been a shadow of its former self ever since the disappearance of the Isle of Val─but the name does still retain some degree of prestige. I only pray it will be enough.

234.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002230_KRILE
234.description: If there are no objections, I shall depart for Sharlayan at once. But before I do, I should also mention the other matter to which I would devote some time during my stay.

235.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002240_KRILE
235.description: After hearing what transpired in the First, I began to question the true nature of Hydaelyn's blessing. A topic I have discussed at some length with Y'shtola...

236.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002250_YSHTOLA
236.description: We were wondering: when was the last time Hydaelyn spoke to you directly?

238.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_A4_000_001_NONE_VOICE
238.description: Near the end of the Dragonsong War.

241.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002260_YSHTOLA
241.description: When you regained Her blessing, was it not? But never since─not in all your time in the First, when you faced the unsundered, the very heart of Zodiark.

242.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002270_YSHTOLA
242.description: When Elidibus sought to make Warriors of Light? That was the voice which calls constantly to all who might hear it. I spoke of <hex:021A020203>direct<hex:021A020103> communication, when Hydaelyn communed solely with you. A far rarer occurrence.

243.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002280_YSHTOLA
243.description: Is the question truly so vexing? Perhaps you fear I will chastise you for giving the wrong answer? Or was it so long ago that you simply can't remember...

244.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002290_KRILE
244.description: History shows us that Hydaelyn is able to awaken the Echo in Her chosen, convey Her will directly, and grant the blessing of Light.

245.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002300_KRILE
245.description: To our knowledge, however, She has not sought to intervene in man's affairs for some considerable time.

246.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002310_URIANGER
246.description: Might not the explanation for that lie with Her choice of champion? Mayhap She is content to trust in <hex:02080DE905FF04686572FF0468697303> judgment.

247.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002320_YSHTOLA
247.description: Mayhap She is. But following my initial discussion with Krile, I made inquiries of my own, and as far as I am able to tell, Hydaelyn has not made Her will known to anyone.

248.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002330_THANCRED
248.description: During my time in the First, the Oracle of Light spoke to me through Ryne. But that was not the will of Hydaelyn. It was Minfilia herself.

249.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002340_YSHTOLA
249.description: Indeed. And while she and Hydaelyn were inextricably linked, Minfilia yet acted of her own volition. A messenger, yes, but one who spoke with her own voice.

250.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002350_KRILE
250.description: I wonder, could Hydaelyn's silence suggest the presence of some disruptive force, perhaps? Some obstacle to communication? While I share Urianger's high opinion of your conduct, I see no reason why She would deny you Her guidance altogether.

251.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002360_KRILE
251.description: Then again, who am I to say? The fact is, we simply don't know. But if the explanation is to be found anywhere, I can think of worse places to look than the archives of Sharlayan─and their research on the aetherial sea in particular.

252.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002370_KRILE
252.description: Resolved though I am to go, believe me when I say that I take no pleasure in the thought of leaving you a member short. Now of all times.

253.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002380_KRILE
253.description: Estinien─we stand on the eve of a struggle that will decide the fate of this star. One in which we Scions may play a telling part. Yet we are but few in number.

254.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002390_KRILE
254.description: And so I must ask you again: will you join us?

255.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002400_ESTINIEN
255.description: You see the world the way you want it to be. I see the world the way it is. You are idealistic to a fault.

256.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002410_ESTINIEN
256.description: But I know you would never turn your back on those in need. Never close your eyes to their suffering. And somehow, your deeds lend truth to your words, giving the lie to my doubts in so doing.

257.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002420_ESTINIEN
257.description: I have seen others draw strength from your belief. In Ishgard, in Ala Mhigo. You inspired them to stand up and fight. To win, no less.

258.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002430_ESTINIEN
258.description: And even when you lost those you held dear, you carried their spirit with you, and made their memory your guiding light. The burden of so many hopes and dreams would be too heavy for most to bear.

259.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002440_ESTINIEN
259.description: But you bear it willingly. As you have shown me, some dreams are too important to let go.

260.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002450_ESTINIEN
260.description: If you have need of my strength, it's yours. After all you've done, how could I refuse?

262.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002470_ALPHINAUD
262.description: Whatever challenges await us, I shall not falter. You have my word.

263.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002480_KRILE
263.description: And now I may bid you farewell, safe in the knowledge that all is as it should be─in this little corner of the world at least.

264.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002490_ALPHINAUD
264.description: You will be sorely missed. Tread warily in Sharlayan...and do try not to let the Forum embroil you in their politics. A forlorn hope, I know, given the individuals involved...

265.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002500_KRILE
265.description: I shall do my very best. Farewell.

267.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002510_FANDANIEL
267.description: Well? Does this one meet with your approval?

268.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002520_FANDANIEL
268.description: Apparently not. Or...could it be that you're still upset about the dragons?

269.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002530_ZENOS
269.description: You are unwise to remind me of so costly a failure.

270.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002540_ZENOS
270.description: It will not affect our plans, I trust.

271.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002550_FANDANIEL
271.description: Oh, hardly at all. Though, admittedly, the chances of us being able to procure any more Meracydian dragons are rather slimmer following Tiamat's reappearance.

272.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002560_FANDANIEL
272.description: But the seeds have been sown, my lord! We have only to wait for them to quicken.

273.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002570_FANDANIEL
273.description: Speaking of preparations, is it safe to assume that you will be ready to control you-know-what?

274.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002580_ZENOS
274.description: The hour draws nigh. This nation, forged for Ascian ends, will finally prove its worth.

275.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002590_FANDANIEL
275.description: A mighty Empire, now no more than an instrument of this star's destruction! What a pleasure it will be to put it to use!

276.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002600_FANDANIEL
276.description: Which brings me back to our earlier topic. My lord─while I appreciate that it is not an easy decision, it really is past time you chose your weapon.

277.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002610_ZENOS
277.description: There is one that I have been meaning to test...

278.name: TEXT_VOICEMAN_05500_002620_FANDANIEL
278.description: Well, well... Not quite what I was expecting. Though I will say, it does seem rather apt.
